def reverse_in_chunks(lst, k):
    result = []
    i = 0
    n = len(lst)
    while i < n:
        chunk = lst[i:i + k]
        j = len(chunk) - 1
        while j >= 0:
            result.append(chunk[j])
            j -= 1
        i += k
    return result
